# ex: implicit addr with outer * operator cancels
ex {
	var p *T
	p.X -> p.Y
}
-- x.go --
package m

type T struct {
	X int
	Y int
}

func F(t T) int {
	return (&t).X
}
-- stdout --
diff old/x.go new/x.go
--- old/x.go
+++ new/x.go
@@ -6,5 +6,5 @@
 }

 func F(t T) int {
-	return (&t).X
+	return (&t).Y
 }
